subject: Action: AR ledger backfill and VAT tag remap for Acme Cloud
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <accounts@acmecloud.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Action: AR ledger backfill and VAT tag remap for Acme Cloud

Hi Maya / Acme team,

We've finished a first pass audit of your account after the July billing migration and found ~€312k of payments that did not apply cleanly to invoices due to entity tagging differences and VAT code mismatches. This is showing up in our AR aging as unapplied/locked items and causing two problems: (1) invoices incorrectly aging into the 90+ bucket, and (2) VAT-reporting lines being split between the UK and IE VAT buckets.

I attached a CSV (acme-backfill-candidates.csv) with the candidate invoice/payment pairs and the suggested target invoice for each payment. Key notes:
- Several payments were credited to the legacy entity (Redwood EU Ltd) while invoices were raised by Redwood Services Ltd — same legal payer but different ledgers.
- VAT tax code on invoices 84321–84328 were stamped with the old IE-VAT-0 code; Acme's remittance shows VAT reclaim expected on those lines.

Requesting:
1) Can you confirm the remittance file for Aug 26–Aug 31 is complete? If you have a PDF we can ingest, please share.
2) For the payments below, we plan to run a ledger backfill (JV) to move the unapplied remittances into the correct AR bucket and reverse the VAT tag on the listed invoice lines. We will provide a JV template for review.

Target timeline: preliminary JV applied Wed 9/15, final sweep Thu 9/16 after your confirmation.

If this looks OK to you, please confirm and I will coordinate with Grace and Karthik to prepare the journal entries.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Revenue Operations Analyst
Redwood Inference

Attachment: acme-backfill-candidates.csv (CSV, 42 rows)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action: AR ledger backfill and VAT tag remap for Acme Cloud

Dylan — thanks for the triage and the CSV. Quick points:
- Please do not post any permanent journals until Acme confirms the remittance PDF. We can apply a staging JV (RB-STG-20260915) for validation then reverse/replace with the final JV (RB-JV-202609).
- I'll own the posting of the staging JV and the sweep once we have Acme's sign-off.
- We will need the JV to include: original payment clearing, reclassification to the correct entity, and a VAT correction line. Our template is attached (JV_template_Redwood.xlsx).

Can Karthik validate the revmap changes so RevenueOps and ASC 606 mapping remain intact? Laura, please keep legal looped if any customer-facing memos are required for audit.

Grace O'Connor
Finance Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: JV_template_Redwood.xlsx (Excel, journal entry template)
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acmecloud.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 12:44:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Action: AR ledger backfill and VAT tag remap for Acme Cloud

Hi Dylan / Grace — thanks for flagging. Apologies, our AP team rotated over in August which is probably why remits were split across accounts. I attached the remittance we have for 26–31 Aug (ACME_remit_Aug2026.pdf).

Notes from our side:
- We confirm payments of €312,074 across 5 bank transfers on 2026-08-28 and 2026-08-29.
- Transfers were processed out of our EU treasury account; we expect the correct VAT treatment should be reclaimed on your end.
- We are OK with a staged JV for validation as long as we get a short memo we can archive for our internal audit.

I'll loop in our treasury contact if you need bank trace IDs.

Best,
Maya Singh
Head of Finance Operations
Acme Cloud Services

Attachment: ACME_remit_Aug2026.pdf (PDF, remittance)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 07:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action: AR ledger backfill and VAT tag remap for Acme Cloud

Quick technical:
- I've reviewed the revmap implications. The invoices in question were mapped to "RSVC-EU-STD" (revcode 2201) in the old system; the migration left a handful tagged with the fallback revcode "9999". Before we run any backfill we should: (a) remap invoices 84321–84328 to 2201, (b) mark the VAT lines as EU-REC (VAT reclaim) rather than IE-NR.
- Proposed revmap CSV attached (revmap-sample.csv) with SKU -> revcode suggestions. If post-JV the revenue recognition periods shift, I will coordinate a short correction schedule with ASC 606 team — target impact is a one-period reclass (no net revenue change).

SQL snippet I tested locally to find affected rows:
SELECT invoice_id, invoice_date, legacy_entity, revcode FROM ar_invoices
WHERE invoice_id IN (84321,84322,84323,84324,84325,84326,84327,84328)
AND revcode = '9999';

If Grace is good with the staging JV approach I can prepare the revmap update package for the migration run immediately after the staging post.

- Karthik
Revenue Systems, Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acmecloud.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action: AR ledger backfill and VAT tag remap for Acme Cloud

Thanks all — short summary and next steps: 
1) Acme confirmed remittance (attached). Grace to post staging JV RB-STG-20260915 on 2026-09-15 COB and share the accounting entries with Acme for archive.
2) Karthik will push the revmap reclassification immediately after staging JV and share revmap-sample.csv.
3) If staging JV validates (no customer disputes), Grace to replace with final JV RB-JV-202609 on 2026-09-16 morning and we will close the 90+ AR bucket for Acme.
4) Laura to draft a 2-line memo for Acme's archive confirming the accounting treatment and that the net revenue is unaffected.

Please reply to confirm owners; I'll kick off the JV staging run once I have Grace's go-ahead.

Dylan
Senior Revenue Operations Analyst
Redwood Inference
